description: Candidate families for identity-free 1-D carbohydrate screening. Numeric shifts are references, not measurements of the unknown.

candidates.name: D-(+)-xylose
candidates.notes: The six-spin model is a provisional topology: H1-H4 plus H5eq/H5ax for each anomer.

candidates.name: D-glucose
candidates.topology: two primary six-spin pyranose anomer components
candidates.notes: Minor furanose/open-chain forms can be added only when residual evidence warrants them.

candidates.name: D-mannose
candidates.topology: two primary six-spin pyranose anomer components
candidates.notes: Mannose has unusual small J1,2 values; do not apply a glucose/xylose J rule blindly.

candidates.name: Sucrose
candidates.notes: Do not treat sucrose as a freely mutarotating alpha/beta mixture.

candidates.name: D-fructose
candidates.notes: Reference-free until a local BMRB/literature shift table is added; 1-D screening must remain REVIEW.
